name: Pearson Airport / North York; formerly Brampton local
description: Before 2015,34 joined Brampton, Malton and Pearson with North York. It became Pearson–Finch before being absorbed into 94.

timeline.event: The combined timetable identifies 34 as Brampton–Bramalea–Malton–Pearson–North York.
34 became Pearson–Yorkdale–Finch, dropping Brampton, Malton and York Mills.
The original 34 table confirms its Pearson–Finch configuration.
34 and 94 merged into expanded 94, ending the separate 34 number.
